outline.chapter_title: 1. Foundations of Reinforcement Learning for Language Models
outline.description: Introduces the core concepts that underpin RL training of large language models, including policies, rewards, importance sampling, and proximal policy updates. Establishes the motivation for sequence‑level optimization.
subtopics: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) mechanics and drawbacks
outline.chapter_title: 2. The Challenges of Large‑Scale Language Model RL
outline.description: Explores the specific instability issues that arise when scaling RL to gigantic models, Mixture‑of‑Experts (MoE) architectures, and long sequences. Explains why token‑level importance ratios become problematic.
subtopics: Impact of response length on variance
outline.description: Contrasts token‑level objectives used in GRPO with the proposal to align rewards and optimization at the sequence level.
subtopics: Misapplication of importance weights in GRPO
Principle of aligning unit of reward with unit of objective
outline.chapter_title: 4. Group Sequence Policy Optimization (GSPO) – Core Idea
outline.description: Presents the GSPO algorithm, detailing its objective function, definition of sequence‑level importance ratio, and advantage estimation.
subtopics: Sequence likelihood ratio definition and length normalization
Group advantage calculation across multiple responses
Clipping mechanism at the sequence level
outline.description: Derives the GSPO gradient, compares it with GRPO’s gradient, and explains why equal token weighting leads to stability.
subtopics: Role of equal weighting in reducing variance
outline.chapter_title: 6. GSPO-token – A Token‑Level Variant for Fine Grained Control
outline.description: Introduces a hybrid variant that retains token‐level advantage flexibility while preserving the stability benefits of GSPO.
subtopics: Definition of per‑token importance ratios using detached gradients
outline.description: Guides readers through concrete implementation choices: batch partitioning, clipping hyperparameters, advantage standardization, and inference‐engine integration.
subtopics: Mini‐batch sampling strategy during RL training
Setting clipping ranges for sequence vs token objectives
outline.description: Outlines the experimental setup used to validate GSPO: model selection, baselines, metrics, and hyperparameter tuning methodology.
subtopics: Cold–start vs pre‐fine tuned base models","Query sets and rollout data management","Evaluation metrics: AIME Pass@1, LiveCodeBench Pass@1, CodeForces Elo","Hyperparameter grid search for clipping ranges"],
